| Category = Beef recipes
| Yield = 2
}}

{{recipe}}

== Ingredients ==
*1 ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (about 700 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Beef#Loin|beef sirloin]], cut into 1 ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (4 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) cubes
*2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] smoked [[Cookbook:Paprika|paprika]]
*1 tbsp kosher salt
*1 tbsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
*1 ½ tbsp [[Cookbook:Cayenne Pepper|cayenne pepper]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Balsamic vinegar|balsamic vinegar]]
*1 large [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], wedged
*Several assorted [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell peppers]], cut into 3-inch (7.5 cm) strips
*1-inch (2.5 cm) slices [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchini]]
*6 bamboo skewers, soaked in water 30 minutes
*1 ½ tsp [[Cookbook:Rosemary|rosemary]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Thyme|thyme]], finely chopped

== Procedure ==
#Combine paprika, salt, pepper, cayenne pepper, olive oil, rosemary, thyme and balsamic vinegar in a gallon (4 liter) size zip-top bag. Add beef and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#Sort beef cubes into equal size rows. Skewer 1 onion wedge, 1 strip bell pepper, 1 slice zucchini from the side, and 3 cubes of meat across the grain in a pattern per skewer.
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] over medium high heat, turning often, 11 minutes for medium. Serve warm.
